title: Basis for Amending a Booked Vacation Package
content:
Changes to a booked package among the Vacation Package Products are dealt with on the following basis.

## Replacing a member of the party

> The following clause is **no longer in force** and is not to be applied: "A member of the party may be replaced only up to the product's name-change deadline before departure, against the product's name-change charge per traveller replaced." It has been superseded by the current basis, and the position it stated no longer governs.

The name-change charge per traveller and the name-change deadline published against each product remain the published figures of that product.

## The approval a change to the party or the dates waits on

A change to the travelling party or the departure date is made only when the operations desk has already recorded an approved change request against this package. The change request relied on is the one the operations desk has recorded, standing in an approved state, raised against the package being changed and identified by its own request reference; it is that record, and not the party's account of having asked for the change, that answers this test.

## Moving the departure date

The departure date may be moved only on a product that allows it, within its ceiling on the number of moves, against its date-change charge per traveller, and the package is re-priced at the product's price for the new dates.

A product that allows no date change refuses the move outright rather than charging for it, and the party's only alternative is cancellation on the product's own ladder.

## Other amendments

Any other amendment carries the product's administration charge per traveller, and correcting the contact address or contact number is free and carries none.

An amendment requested after the balance has fallen due is priced as a cancellation and a rebooking, because the suppliers have already been paid.

Substituting one component of the itinerary for another carries the product's component change charge and is available only where the supplier can make the substitution.

superseded_clauses: A member of the party may be replaced only up to the product's name-change deadline before departure, against the product's name-change charge per traveller replaced.
